Name: Horny FurFur
Author: MozJhin
Description:
2025/9/20更新：
所有星露谷的女性村民都擁有各自的母獸形象，包括人物外表，肖像以及各自的泳裝及冬季服裝變化。

私心新增海莉特別版，改變海莉的對話框格局，頭像變為全身像，並新增一個3心好感度事件( R18注意！)，目前僅有nsfw版本，並僅有人物像素外表會跟隨季節變化，全身像不論季節場地都會是一般服裝，有興趣的可以試著下載看看！（我們正在規劃可結婚女性角色的全身像對話框作為下一次更新:D  ）

**注意！ 此版本須額外下載 "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22678]﻿Dialogue Display Framework Continued (DDFC)[/url]" 才可運作，請記得下載該模組，並於模組設定(標題畫面左下角齒輪圖樣)中，選擇“HornyFurFur”選項，並選擇” FullbodyHaleyport" 選項，以啟用海莉全身像。
  - DDFC下載方式：
﻿1. 點擊上方黃字超連結，至該頁面下載DDFC模組
﻿2. 將下載的文件解壓縮後，放入Ｍods資料夾
﻿3. 打開遊戲，於模組設定(標題畫面左下角齒輪圖樣)中，點擊“HornyFurFur”選項，取消“FurFurPort"選項並選擇” FullbodyHaleyport" 選項，以啟用海莉母獸全身像。
4.打開你的存檔，享受模組！

2025/9/25 update:
All the female villagers have their own unique furry appearance, include sprite, portraits and clothing variations of beach and winter, hope you enjoy :D 

Haley special edition added!  Change the arrangement of Haley's dialogue block, change the origin portrait to full body portrait, and add a new 3 hearts event (R18). For now there's no winter & beach variation for full body portrait, please try download it if you're interested! (We are now planning to make female marriage villagers' fullbody portrait as next update!)

**Warning! To make the this edition to work, you must download "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22678]﻿﻿Dialogue Display Framework Continued (DDFC)[/url]﻿". Remember to download DDFC, and change the HornyFurFur config in config setting to "FullbodyHaleyport" in game.
﻿- How to download DDFC:
﻿ 1. click the link above, enter mod page and download it.
﻿ 2. unzip all files and put them into "Mods" folder.
﻿ 3. open your game, click the left button side gear sign, click "HornyFurFur" config, change "FurFurPort" ﻿option to "FullbodyHaleyport".
﻿ 4. load your game save, and enjoy the mod!
